questions.q: Why does Perlmutter say eggs and butter are not the real cholesterol problem?
a: Your body adjusts its own production based on what you eat
Cholesterol in food is never absorbed by the body
Only fried foods raise cholesterol levels
Genetics decide cholesterol and diet has no effect
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the body produces less cholesterol when you eat more, and more when you eat less.

questions.q: Which cholesterol ratio does the summary say matters most?
a: Total cholesterol divided by HDL, ideally 3.5 or lower
LDL divided by total cholesterol, ideally below 2
HDL divided by LDL, ideally above 5
Triglycerides divided by LDL, ideally around 1
questions.why: Lesson 1 says dividing total cholesterol by HDL should stay at 3.5 or below.

questions.q: What does the summary say about diet creating new brain neurons?
a: It has only been seen in animals, not in humans
It has been proven in large human trials
It happens only during childhood
It was disproven in every study
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the effect has been observed in mice, but no studies prove it in humans.

questions.q: What happens when leptin drops by about 20 percent?
a: Appetite and carb cravings rise by about 24 percent
Hunger falls and energy rises sharply
Sleep quality improves the same night
The body burns fat much faster
questions.why: Lesson 3 says a 20 percent leptin drop raises appetite and carb cravings by 24 percent.

questions.q: What does the summary say is the only way to affect leptin levels?
a: Getting enough sleep
Taking a daily supplement
Eating more protein at breakfast
Exercising on an empty stomach
questions.why: Lesson 3 says sleep is the only thing that impacts leptin, and there are no supplements for it.
